title: Connect your Ledger

steps.unlockPin: Unlock with your PIN on the device
steps.openEthereumApp: Open the Ethereum app on your Ledger

accessDenied: Could not access the Ledger. Close Ledger Live if it is open, or check USB permissions (Linux: udev rule).
connectTimeout: Ledger did not respond in time. Make sure it's unlocked with the Ethereum app open, then try again.
